recipes.title: Microwave Rice & Bean Burrito Bowl
recipes.description: Fluffy rice, warm seasoned black beans and melty cheese, all made in one microwave. A weeknight bowl in about 15 minutes.

steps.title: Prep the beans
steps.text: Drain and rinse the black beans. Tip them into a microwave-safe bowl with a pinch of salt, the cumin and a spoonful of the salsa.
steps.tip: Rinsing removes the starchy canning liquid, so the beans taste cleaner.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice and put it in a large microwave-safe bowl with twice as much water and a pinch of salt. Cover loosely and microwave for 8 minutes, then let it stand covered for 2 minutes. Fluff and divide between two bowls.
steps.tip: Use a big bowl. Rice foams up as it cooks.

steps.title: Heat the beans
steps.text: Microwave the beans for 2 minutes. Stir, then mash about a third of them with a fork so they turn creamy.

steps.title: Build the bowls
steps.text: Spoon the warm beans over the rice, then scatter with the cheese.

steps.title: Melt the cheese
steps.text: Microwave each bowl for 30 to 45 seconds until the cheese melts.

steps.title: Top and serve
steps.text: Top with the rest of the salsa and the cilantro. Taste, add salt if needed, and dig in.

recipes.title: Chicken Tinga Tacos
recipes.description: Shredded chicken simmered in a smoky tomato and chipotle sauce, piled into warm tortillas.

steps.title: Poach the chicken
steps.text: Put the chicken in a pot, cover with salted water and simmer for 15 minutes until cooked through. Lift it out and shred it with two forks.
steps.tip: Chicken is safe once the thickest part reaches 165°F / 74°C.

steps.title: Soften the onion
steps.text: Heat a little oil in a skillet and sauté the onion for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic for 1 minute.

steps.title: Make the tinga sauce
steps.text: Stir in the crushed tomatoes, chipotle peppers and oregano. Simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Coat the chicken
steps.text: Fold the shredded chicken into the sauce and cook for 3 minutes so it soaks up the flavor.

steps.title: Warm the tortillas
steps.text: Warm the corn tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.

steps.title: Fill and serve
steps.text: Fill the tortillas with chicken tinga and top with avocado and cilantro.

recipes.title: Black Bean Quesadillas
recipes.description: Crisp, golden tortillas stuffed with mashed black beans and melted cheese.

steps.title: Mash the beans
steps.text: Mash the black beans with the cumin and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Fill and fold
steps.text: Spread the beans over half of each tortilla, scatter with cheese and fold.

steps.title: Crisp them up
steps.text: Cook in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and the cheese melts.

steps.title: Slice and serve
steps.text: Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
recipes.description: Spaghetti tossed with golden garlic, chili and olive oil. A pantry dinner that tastes far better than it should.

steps.title: Boil the pasta
steps.text: Cook the spaghetti in a large pot of well-salted boiling water for 9 minutes. Save a mug of the pasta water before draining.

steps.title: Toast the garlic
steps.text: Meanwhile, warm the olive oil and garlic in a frying pan over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes until pale gold. Add the red pepper flakes.

steps.title: Toss together
steps.text: Add the drained spaghetti and a splash of pasta water and toss for 1 minute until glossy.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Toss in the parsley and serve with parmesan.

recipes.title: Chicken Piccata
recipes.description: Thin chicken cutlets in a bright, buttery lemon and caper sauce.

steps.title: Prep the cutlets
steps.text: Slice each chicken breast in half horizontally, season with salt and pepper and dust with the flour.

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.text: Sear the cutlets in the oil and 1 tbsp butter in a skillet for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Set aside.
steps.tip: Cooked through means 165°F / 74°C in the thickest part.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Pour the chicken broth and lemon juice into the pan, scrape up the browned bits and add the capers. Simmer for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Finish with butter
steps.text: Swirl in the remaining butter, return the chicken to the pan for 1 minute and scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Egg Fried Rice
recipes.description: Day-old rice fried hot and fast with egg, scallions and soy sauce.

steps.title: Scramble the eggs
steps.text: Heat half the oil in a wok over high heat. Scramble the eggs for 1 minute until just set, then tip them onto a plate.

steps.title: Fry the rice
steps.text: Add the remaining oil and the rice. Stir-fry for 3 minutes, pressing out any clumps.

steps.title: Add the veg
steps.text: Add the peas and most of the scallions and stir-fry for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Season and serve
steps.text: Return the eggs, add the soy sauce and sesame oil, toss and serve topped with the rest of the scallions.

recipes.title: Kung Pao Chicken
recipes.description: Tender chicken, peanuts and dried chilies in a glossy sweet, sour and numbing sauce.

steps.title: Coat the chicken
steps.text: Toss the chicken with the cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy sauce.

steps.title: Mix the sauce
steps.text: Stir together the remaining soy sauce, rice vinegar and sugar.

steps.title: Stir-fry the chicken
steps.text: Stir-fry the chicken in a hot oiled wok for 5 minutes until browned and cooked through. Set aside.

steps.title: Bloom the aromatics
steps.text: Fry the dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns for 30 seconds, then add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds more.

steps.title: Bring it together
steps.text: Return the chicken, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy. Stir through the peanuts and scallions.

recipes.title: Chicken Teriyaki
recipes.description: Crisp-skinned chicken thighs lacquered in a homemade teriyaki glaze.

steps.title: Mix the glaze
steps.text: Stir the soy sauce, mirin, sugar and sake together.

steps.title: Crisp the chicken
steps.text: Cook the chicken skin side down in a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat for 8 minutes until crisp, then turn and cook for 5 minutes more.
steps.tip: Done when the juices run clear and it reaches 165°F / 74°C.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Pour off the fat, add the glaze and simmer for 2 minutes, turning the chicken until coated and sticky.

steps.title: Slice and serve
steps.text: Slice the chicken, spoon over the glaze and serve on rice with sesame seeds and scallions.

recipes.title: Miso Soup with Tofu
recipes.description: A gentle, savory broth with silken tofu, wakame and scallions.

steps.title: Heat the dashi
steps.text: Bring the water and dashi powder to a simmer in a saucepan.

steps.title: Add the tofu and wakame
steps.text: Add the tofu and wakame and simmer gently for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Stir in the miso
steps.text: Turn off the heat. Whisk the miso with a ladle of broth, then stir it back into the pot.
steps.tip: Boiling miso dulls its flavor, so add it off the heat.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Ladle into bowls and top with scallions.

recipes.title: Chana Masala
recipes.description: Chickpeas simmered in a tangy, spiced tomato and onion gravy.

steps.title: Bloom the cumin
steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a saucepan and fry the cumin seeds for 30 seconds until fragrant.

steps.title: Cook the aromatics
steps.text: Add the onion and cook for 8 minutes until golden, then add the garlic, ginger and chili for 1 minute.

steps.title: Build the gravy
steps.text: Stir in the turmeric, garam masala and crushed tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer the chickpeas
steps.text: Add the chickpeas and a splash of water and simmer for 10 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken the sauce.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Squeeze in the lemon, season with salt and scatter with cilantro.

recipes.title: Butter Chicken
recipes.description: Marinated chicken in a silky, mildly spiced tomato and cream sauce.

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.text: Mix the chicken with the yogurt, half the garam masala, the chili powder and a pinch of salt. Leave for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.text: Brown the chicken in 1 tbsp butter in a large skillet for 5 minutes. Set aside.

steps.title: Make the base
steps.text: Melt the rest of the butter and cook the onion for 6 minutes, then add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.text: Add the tomato puree and remaining garam masala and simmer for 8 minutes.

steps.title: Finish with cream
steps.text: Stir in the cream and chicken and simmer for 8 minutes until the chicken is cooked through. Top with cilantro.

recipes.title: Omelette aux Fines Herbes
recipes.description: A soft, rolled French omelette with butter and fresh herbs.

steps.title: Beat the eggs
steps.text: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and most of the herbs until smooth.

steps.title: Cook gently
steps.text: Melt the butter in a nonstick frying pan over medium-low heat. Add the eggs and stir with a fork while shaking the pan for 1 to 2 minutes until softly set.

steps.title: Roll and serve
steps.text: Tilt the pan, roll the omelette onto a plate and scatter with the remaining herbs.

recipes.title: Ratatouille
recipes.description: Summer vegetables slowly stewed with garlic, tomato and herbs.

steps.title: Brown the eggplant
steps.text: Sauté the eggplant in half the olive oil in a large pot for 6 minutes until golden. Set aside.

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.text: Add the remaining oil, onion and bell pepper and cook for 5 minutes, then add the zucchini and garlic for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Stew
steps.text: Return the eggplant, add the crushed tomatoes and thyme, cover and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring now and then.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.text: Season, rest for 5 minutes and tear over the basil.

recipes.title: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow)
recipes.description: Minced chicken stir-fried with chilies, garlic and holy basil, served over rice with a fried egg.

steps.title: Pound the aromatics
steps.text: Roughly pound or finely chop the garlic and chilies together.

steps.title: Stir-fry the chicken
steps.text: Stir-fry the garlic and chilies in a hot oiled wok for 30 seconds, then add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes until no pink remains.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Add the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce and sugar and toss for 1 minute. Fold in the basil until it wilts.

steps.title: Fry the eggs
steps.text: Fry the eggs in hot oil for 2 minutes until the edges are crisp.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve the chicken over the rice, topped with the eggs.

recipes.title: Green Curry with Vegetables
recipes.description: Creamy coconut green curry with crisp vegetables and tofu.

steps.title: Fry the curry paste
steps.text: Fry the curry paste in a splash of the coconut milk in a saucepan for 2 minutes until fragrant.

steps.title: Add the coconut milk
steps.text: Pour in the rest of the coconut milk with half a can of water and bring to a simmer.

steps.title: Simmer the vegetables
steps.text: Add the tofu, green beans, bell pepper and zucchini and simmer for 8 minutes until just tender.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Season with the soy sauce, sugar and lime juice.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve over rice with Thai basil.

recipes.title: Tortilla Española
recipes.description: A thick, tender potato and onion omelette, golden outside and just set inside.

steps.title: Cook the potatoes
steps.text: Cook the potatoes and onion gently in the olive oil in a nonstick skillet for 20 minutes until soft but not browned. Drain, saving the oil.

steps.title: Combine with eggs
steps.text: Beat the eggs with salt and fold in the potatoes. Rest for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the first side
steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp of the saved oil in the skillet and cook the tortilla over medium-low heat for 6 minutes.

steps.title: Flip and finish
steps.text: Flip it onto a plate, slide it back into the skillet and cook for 4 minutes more.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.text: Rest for 5 minutes and serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Garlic Shrimp (Gambas al Ajillo)
recipes.description: Shrimp sizzled in olive oil with plenty of garlic, chili and paprika.

steps.title: Infuse the oil
steps.text: Warm the olive oil, garlic and red pepper flakes in a skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes until the garlic sizzles.

steps.title: Cook the shrimp
steps.text: Add the shrimp and paprika and cook for 3 minutes, turning once, until pink and opaque.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Squeeze over the lemon and scatter with parsley. Serve with bread to mop up the oil.

recipes.title: Greek Salad (Horiatiki)
recipes.description: Tomatoes, cucumber, peppers and olives under a slab of feta and a pour of olive oil.

steps.title: Chop the vegetables
steps.text: Cut the tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper and onion and pile them into a bowl.

steps.title: Dress
steps.text: Season with salt, add the olives and drizzle with the vinegar and olive oil.

steps.title: Top and serve
steps.text: Lay the feta on top, sprinkle with oregano and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Souvlaki
recipes.description: Lemon and oregano chicken skewers with warm pita and a quick yogurt sauce.

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.text: Toss the chicken with the juice of the lemon, olive oil, oregano, two-thirds of the garlic and salt. Leave for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Squeeze the grated cucumber dry and stir it into the yogurt with the rest of the garlic and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Grill the skewers
steps.text: Thread the chicken onto skewers and grill over high heat for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.

steps.title: Warm the pita and serve
steps.text: Grill the pita for 30 seconds per side and serve with the skewers and sauce.

recipes.title: Vegetable Bibimbap
recipes.description: Rice topped with seasoned vegetables, a fried egg and spicy gochujang sauce.

steps.title: Mix the sauce
steps.text: Stir the gochujang with half the sesame oil, the sugar and 1 tbsp water.

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.text: Sauté the carrot and zucchini separately in a little oil in a skillet for 2 minutes each, then wilt the spinach and bean sprouts for 1 minute. Season each with a little soy sauce and sesame oil.

steps.title: Fry the eggs
steps.text: Fry the eggs in the skillet for 2 to 3 minutes until the whites are set.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Divide the rice between bowls, arrange the vegetables on top and add the eggs.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon over the sauce, sprinkle with sesame seeds and mix it all together at the table.

recipes.title: Kimchi Fried Rice
recipes.description: Tangy, spicy fried rice with kimchi, finished with a runny fried egg.

steps.title: Fry the kimchi
steps.text: Fry the kimchi in a little oil in a skillet for 3 minutes until it starts to caramelize.

steps.title: Fry the rice
steps.text: Add the rice, kimchi juice and gochujang and fry for 4 minutes, pressing the rice into the pan.

steps.title: Fry the eggs
steps.text: In another pan, fry the eggs for 2 minutes until the whites are set.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Stir the sesame oil through the rice, top with the eggs and scallions.

recipes.title: Lemongrass Chicken
recipes.description: Caramelized chicken thighs with lemongrass, garlic and fish sauce over rice.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Toss the chicken with the lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce and half the sugar. Leave for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Caramelize the sugar
steps.text: Melt the rest of the sugar with 1 tbsp water in a skillet for 2 minutes until amber.

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.text: Add the chicken, shallot and chili and cook for 10 minutes, stirring, until sticky and cooked through.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve over rice with cilantro.

recipes.title: Fresh Spring Rolls
recipes.description: Rice paper rolls packed with shrimp, herbs and noodles, with peanut dipping sauce.

steps.title: Cook the noodles
steps.text: Boil the vermicelli for 3 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water.

steps.title: Make the dipping sauce
steps.text: Whisk the peanut butter, hoisin sauce, lime juice and 3 tbsp warm water until smooth.

steps.title: Soften the wrappers
steps.text: Dip one rice paper wrapper in warm water for 10 seconds and lay it flat.

steps.title: Fill and roll
steps.text: Lay shrimp, noodles, lettuce, carrot, mint and cilantro on the wrapper, fold in the sides and roll tightly. Repeat.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve the rolls with the dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Classic Cheeseburger
recipes.description: Juicy smashed beef patties with melted cheese, pickles and all the fixings.

steps.title: Shape the patties
steps.text: Divide the beef into 4 balls and season generously with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Smash and sear
steps.text: Smash each ball flat in a very hot skillet and sear for 3 minutes until a deep crust forms.

steps.title: Flip and melt
steps.text: Flip, top with the cheese, and cook for 2 minutes more.

steps.title: Toast the buns
steps.text: Toast the buns cut side down in the skillet for 1 minute.

steps.title: Build the burgers
steps.text: Layer the buns with lettuce, tomato, patties, onion, pickles and sauces.

recipes.title: Stovetop Mac and Cheese
recipes.description: Creamy, cheesy macaroni made in one pot, no baking needed.

steps.title: Boil the macaroni
steps.text: Cook the macaroni in a pot of salted boiling water for 7 minutes until just tender. Drain.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Melt the butter in the same pot, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk and simmer for 4 minutes until thickened.

steps.title: Melt in the cheese
steps.text: Take the pot off the heat and stir in the cheddar and mustard powder until smooth.

steps.title: Combine and serve
steps.text: Fold in the macaroni and season to taste.

recipes.title: Silky Hummus
recipes.description: Smooth, creamy chickpea dip with tahini, lemon and garlic.

steps.title: Blend the tahini
steps.text: Blend the tahini, lemon juice and garlic for 1 minute until pale and thick.

steps.title: Add the chickpeas
steps.text: Add the chickpeas, cumin and a pinch of salt and blend for 2 minutes, adding the ice water a spoonful at a time until silky.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spread in a bowl, drizzle with the olive oil and dust with paprika.

recipes.title: Fattoush
recipes.description: A crunchy chopped salad with toasted pita, sumac and a sharp lemon dressing.

steps.title: Toast the pita
steps.text: Tear the pita into pieces, toss with a little olive oil and bake at 400°F / 200°C for 8 minutes until crisp.

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.text: Whisk the lemon juice, remaining olive oil, sumac and salt.

steps.title: Chop the salad
steps.text: Combine the lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, radishes, scallions, parsley and mint in a big bowl.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.text: Toss with the dressing and the toasted pita just before serving.

recipes.title: Menemen
recipes.description: Soft-scrambled eggs cooked into peppers and tomatoes, eaten straight from the pan.

steps.title: Soften the peppers
steps.text: Sauté the peppers in the olive oil in a skillet for 5 minutes until soft.

steps.title: Cook the tomatoes
steps.text: Add the tomatoes and pepper flakes and simmer for 6 minutes until jammy.

steps.title: Scramble in the eggs
steps.text: Crack in the eggs and stir gently over low heat for 2 to 3 minutes until just set.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve straight from the pan with bread.

recipes.title: Red Lentil Soup (Mercimek Çorbası)
recipes.description: A velvety red lentil soup brightened with lemon and a sizzle of paprika butter.

steps.title: Soften the vegetables
steps.text: Cook the onion and carrot in a little oil in a large pot for 5 minutes. Stir in the tomato paste and cumin for 1 minute.

steps.title: Simmer the lentils
steps.text: Add the lentils and vegetable broth and simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils fall apart.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend the soup until smooth and season with salt.

steps.title: Paprika butter and serve
steps.text: Melt the butter with the paprika until it sizzles, drizzle over the soup and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Chicken Tagine with Lemon & Olives
recipes.description: Chicken braised with warm spices, preserved lemon and green olives.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.text: Season the chicken and brown it in oil in a heavy pot for 6 minutes. Set aside.

steps.title: Cook the spices
steps.text: Cook the onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger, cumin, turmeric and cinnamon for 1 minute.

steps.title: Braise
steps.text: Return the chicken, add the chicken broth, cover and simmer for 35 minutes.

steps.title: Add lemon and olives
steps.text: Stir in the preserved lemon and olives and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Scatter with cilantro and serve with couscous or bread.

recipes.title: Chickpea & Vegetable Couscous
recipes.description: Fluffy couscous under a fragrant stew of chickpeas, carrots and zucchini.

steps.title: Start the stew
steps.text: Cook the onion in oil in a large pot for 5 minutes, then stir in the ras el hanout for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Simmer the vegetables
steps.text: Add the carrots, crushed tomatoes and vegetable broth and simmer for 10 minutes. Add the zucchini, chickpeas and raisins and simmer for 8 minutes more.

steps.title: Soak the couscous
steps.text: Pour 1½ cups just-boiled water over the couscous with a pinch of salt, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon the stew over the couscous and scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Moqueca (Fish & Coconut Stew)
recipes.description: White fish gently cooked in coconut milk with peppers, tomatoes and lime.
ingredients: 1.5 lb white fish fillets, cut into chunks

steps.title: Marinate the fish
steps.text: Toss the fish with the lime juice, garlic and salt. Leave for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Layer the vegetables
steps.text: Cook the onion and bell pepper in oil in a wide pot for 5 minutes, then add the tomatoes and paprika.

steps.title: Simmer with coconut
steps.text: Nestle in the fish, pour over the coconut milk and simmer gently, covered, for 10 minutes until the fish flakes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Scatter with cilantro and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Weeknight Feijoada-Style Stew
recipes.description: Black beans simmered with smoky sausage and bacon, a shortcut take on Brazil’s classic.

steps.title: Crisp the meats
steps.text: Cook the bacon in a large pot for 5 minutes, then add the sausage and brown for 4 minutes.

steps.title: Add the aromatics
steps.text: Add the onion and garlic and cook for 5 minutes until soft.

steps.title: Simmer the beans
steps.text: Add the black beans with their liquid, the bay leaves and 1 cup water and simmer for 20 minutes until thick.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with rice and orange slices.

recipes.title: Lomo Saltado
recipes.description: A smoky beef stir-fry with tomatoes, onions and soy, served with fries and rice.

steps.title: Bake the fries
steps.text: Bake the fries in the oven according to the package, about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Sear the beef
steps.text: Sear the beef in batches in a very hot oiled wok for 2 minutes until browned. Set aside.

steps.title: Stir-fry the vegetables
steps.text: Stir-fry the onion, garlic and chili for 2 minutes, then add the tomatoes for 1 minute.

steps.title: Sauce and toss
steps.text: Return the beef, add the soy sauce and vinegar and toss for 1 minute. Fold in the fries and cilantro.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Peruvian Quinoa Salad
recipes.description: Quinoa with corn, beans, peppers and a lime and cilantro dressing.

steps.title: Cook the quinoa
steps.text: Simmer the quinoa in 2 cups salted water, covered, for 15 minutes. Spread out to cool.

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.text: Whisk the lime juice, olive oil and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Toss together
steps.text: Combine the quinoa, black beans, corn, bell pepper, onion and cilantro with the dressing.

recipes.title: Jerk Chicken
recipes.description: Chicken marinated in a fiery scotch bonnet, allspice and thyme paste, then roasted until charred.

steps.title: Blend the marinade
steps.text: Blend the scallions, peppers, garlic, ginger, allspice, thyme, soy sauce, lime juice and sugar into a paste.
steps.tip: Scotch bonnets are very hot. Wash your hands after handling them.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Rub the paste over the chicken and leave for at least 20 minutes.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Roast in the oven at 425°F / 220°C for 35 minutes, turning once, until charred and cooked through.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.text: Rest for 5 minutes and serve with rice and peas.

recipes.title: Rice and Peas
recipes.description: Rice cooked with kidney beans, coconut milk, thyme and allspice.

steps.title: Build the pot
steps.text: Put the kidney beans with their liquid, coconut milk, garlic, scallions, thyme and allspice in a pot with 1 cup water and bring to a simmer.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Stir in the rice and a good pinch of salt, cover and cook on low for 20 minutes until the liquid is absorbed.

steps.title: Rest and fluff
steps.text: Rest off the heat for 5 minutes, remove the thyme and scallions and fluff with a fork.

recipes.title: Misir Wot (Spiced Red Lentils)
recipes.description: Red lentils stewed with onions and berbere spice until rich and silky.

steps.title: Cook the onions
steps.text: Cook the onions in a dry pot for 5 minutes, then add the oil and cook for 8 minutes more until soft and golden.

steps.title: Bloom the berbere
steps.text: Stir in the garlic, ginger, tomato paste and berbere and cook for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer the lentils
steps.text: Add the lentils and 4 cups water and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring often, until thick.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Season with salt and serve with injera or rice.

recipes.title: Gomen (Ethiopian Collard Greens)
recipes.description: Collard greens gently braised with garlic, ginger and green chili.

steps.title: Soften the onion
steps.text: Cook the onion in the oil in a large pot for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and chili for 1 minute.

steps.title: Braise the greens
steps.text: Add the collard greens and 1/2 cup water, cover and simmer for 15 minutes until tender.

steps.title: Season and serve
steps.text: Season with salt and serve warm.

recipes.title: Jollof Rice
recipes.description: Rice cooked in a smoky, spiced tomato and pepper sauce until every grain is red.

steps.title: Blend the base
steps.text: Blend the crushed tomatoes, bell pepper, scotch bonnet and one onion until smooth.

steps.title: Fry the tomato paste
steps.text: Slice the other onion and fry it in the oil in a heavy pot for 5 minutes, then add the tomato paste and fry for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the sauce
steps.text: Add the blended base, curry powder, thyme and bay leaves and simmer for 15 minutes until reduced.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Stir in the rice and chicken broth, cover tightly and cook on low for 25 minutes until tender.
steps.tip: A little crust on the bottom is prized. Don’t stir it away.

recipes.title: Groundnut Stew (Maafe)
recipes.description: A rich peanut and tomato stew with chicken and sweet potato.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.text: Brown the chicken in oil in a large pot for 6 minutes. Set aside.

steps.title: Cook the aromatics
steps.text: Cook the onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and tomato paste for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Whisk the peanut butter into the chicken broth and add it to the pot with the chicken and sweet potato. Simmer for 25 minutes.

steps.title: Wilt the spinach and serve
steps.text: Stir in the spinach until wilted and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Adobo
recipes.description: Chicken braised in vinegar, soy sauce, garlic and bay until glossy and tender.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Combine the chicken with the soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaves and peppercorns. Leave for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Braise
steps.text: Bring everything to a boil in a pot, then cover and simmer for 25 minutes.

steps.title: Brown and reduce
steps.text: Lift out the chicken and brown it in a hot skillet for 4 minutes. Meanwhile, boil the sauce with the sugar for 5 minutes until syrupy.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pour the sauce over the chicken and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Pancit Canton
recipes.description: Stir-fried egg noodles with chicken, cabbage and carrots in a savory sauce.
ingredients: 8 oz pancit canton or egg noodles

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.text: Stir-fry the chicken in oil in a wok for 4 minutes until cooked through. Set aside.

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.text: Stir-fry the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the carrot and cabbage for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the noodles
steps.text: Add the chicken broth, soy sauce and oyster sauce, bring to a boil and add the noodles. Toss for 3 minutes until the liquid is absorbed.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Return the chicken, toss and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Nasi Goreng
recipes.description: Indonesian fried rice with sweet soy, chili and a fried egg on top.

steps.title: Fry the aromatics
steps.text: Stir-fry the shallots, garlic and chili in oil in a wok for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Fry the rice
steps.text: Add the rice, kecap manis and soy sauce and stir-fry for 4 minutes until every grain is coated.

steps.title: Fry the eggs
steps.text: Fry the eggs in another pan for 2 minutes until the edges crisp.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top the rice with the eggs and serve with cucumber and fried shallots.

recipes.title: Gado-Gado
recipes.description: A warm vegetable salad with eggs and tofu under a rich peanut sauce.

steps.title: Boil the eggs and potatoes
steps.text: Boil the potatoes for 12 minutes and the eggs for 9 minutes. Cool the eggs in cold water and peel them.

steps.title: Blanch the vegetables
steps.text: Blanch the green beans, cabbage and bean sprouts in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain.

steps.title: Fry the tofu
steps.text: Fry the tofu in oil in a skillet for 6 minutes until golden on all sides.

steps.title: Make the peanut sauce
steps.text: Whisk the peanut butter, kecap manis, lime juice, grated garlic and 1/3 cup hot water until smooth.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Arrange everything on a platter with the halved eggs and cucumber and pour over the sauce.

recipes.title: Kuku Sabzi (Herb Frittata)
recipes.description: A vivid green Persian frittata packed with fresh herbs.

steps.title: Chop the herbs
steps.text: Finely chop the parsley, cilantro, dill and scallions.

steps.title: Mix the batter
steps.text: Whisk the eggs with the turmeric, baking powder and salt, then fold in the herbs and walnuts.

steps.title: Cook slowly
steps.text: Heat the oil in a nonstick skillet, pour in the mixture, cover and cook on low for 15 minutes until set on top.

steps.title: Flip and finish
steps.text: Cut into quarters, flip each piece and cook for 5 minutes more. Serve warm or cold.

recipes.title: Saffron Chicken Kebabs (Joojeh Kabab)
recipes.description: Chicken marinated in saffron, yogurt and lemon, grilled until golden.

steps.title: Bloom the saffron
steps.text: Grind the saffron with a pinch of sugar and steep it in 3 tbsp hot water for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Mix the chicken with the yogurt, onion, lemon juice, half the saffron and salt. Leave for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Grill
steps.text: Thread onto skewers and grill for 10 to 12 minutes, turning and basting with the butter and remaining saffron.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Pork Schnitzel
recipes.description: Thin pork cutlets in a crisp breadcrumb crust, served with lemon.

steps.title: Pound the cutlets
steps.text: Pound the pork between two sheets of plastic wrap to 1/4 inch thick and season.

steps.title: Bread them
steps.text: Dredge each cutlet in flour, then beaten eggs, then breadcrumbs, without pressing the crumbs on.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Shallow fry in hot oil in a large skillet for 2 to 3 minutes per side until deep golden. Fry in batches.
steps.tip: Pork is safe at 145°F / 63°C with a short rest.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Drain on paper towels and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Bratkartoffeln (Pan-Fried Potatoes)
recipes.description: Crispy pan-fried potatoes with onion and bacon.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.text: Boil the whole potatoes for 15 minutes until just tender. Cool slightly and slice.

steps.title: Crisp the bacon
steps.text: Cook the bacon in a large skillet for 4 minutes until crisp.

steps.title: Fry the potatoes
steps.text: Add the butter and potatoes and fry for 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden. Add the onion for the last 5 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Season and scatter with chives.

recipes.title: Shepherd’s Pie
recipes.description: Savory minced lamb and vegetables under a fluffy, golden mashed potato top.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.text: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes until tender, then mash with the butter, milk and salt.

steps.title: Brown the lamb
steps.text: Brown the lamb in a large skillet for 6 minutes, then add the onion and carrots and cook for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Make the filling
steps.text: Stir in the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce and beef broth and simmer for 10 minutes. Add the peas.

steps.title: Top and bake
steps.text: Spoon the filling into a baking dish, spread the mash on top and bake at 400°F / 200°C for 25 minutes until golden.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.text: Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Jacket Potato with Beans & Cheese
recipes.description: A fluffy baked potato split open and piled with baked beans and melted cheese.

steps.title: Microwave the potatoes
steps.text: Prick the potatoes all over with a fork and microwave for 10 to 12 minutes, turning halfway, until soft in the middle.

steps.title: Heat the beans
steps.text: Microwave the baked beans in a covered bowl for 2 minutes, stirring halfway.

steps.title: Fill and serve
steps.text: Split the potatoes, add the butter and season, then pile on the beans and cheese.
